$description: Theme-invariant motion: three durations and the one easing of the reveal choreography. Not emitted as Tailwind utilities (no --text/--tracking-style namespace for them) — CSS consumes them via var(--duration-*) / var(--ease-out-expo), framer-motion via src/lib/motion.ts which parses TOKENS_DEFAULT into seconds / a cubic-bezier array. Calibrated to the durations the reveals already rendered (chrome 500ms, headers 700ms, chrome controls 200ms).

ease-out-expo.$description: The single easing of the motion system; replaces the [0.22,1,0.36,1] literals that were hand-duplicated across WindowChrome, About, Dock and CliTerminal.
